source.title: Head of Operations, Intelligence Systems
source.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 We are looking for a Head of Operations to join our rapidly growing Intelligence Systems team. In this role you will be responsible for all business operations for the business line you support. Your work will vary from quick-turn operational fire-fighting, to building and redesigning processes, to leading high-impact strategic projects. This role requires you to be a trusted partner to each part of the business, and to work with and support the Division leadership teams to achieve our strategic objectives.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 
 Partner to the GM — Serve as the right hand to the General Manager of Intelligence Systems, responsible for all internal operations of the business line.

 Act as COO of the business line — Drive day-to-day business operations for Intelligence Systems. This includes business planning & organization design, financial tracking, talent planning & people operations, staffing and hiring, corporate governance, go-to-market, real estate & facility planning, security & infrastructure compliance, proposal & legal support, and sharing the division's narrative — working with cross-functional partners across each of these domains.

 Lead the BizOps team — Lead the Business Operations team within Intelligence Systems, composed of a Business Execution/Services team and Business Analytics, with the potential to include Production Operations/Analytics.

 Own the bottom line — Own the business line P&L and burn rate. Partner with Finance and FP&A to track financial health against division goals, take action to keep operating expenses within budget, and recommend strategies to drive toward margin targets.

 Define growth strategy — Define the growth strategy for Intelligence Systems in partnership with the Intelligence Systems Leadership Team, and lead strategic initiatives in line with business line priorities.

 Enable the engineering mission — Support the growth, execution, and engineering of the business line with operational support.

 Scale the organization — Problem solve to enable the business line to operate as efficiently as possible and scale accordingly.

 Represent the business externally — Build senior leader engagement and external interface strategy (e.g., conferences, press releases, partnerships).

 Build partnerships — Build, negotiate, and execute partnerships across industry.

 Support M&A activity — Identify targets and engage in diligence.

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 10-15+ years of professional experience in operations.

 Strong communication skills; trusted by executives and colleagues alike — Demonstrated ability to translate and articulate thoughts clearly and simply across a wide range of roles (software engineers, finance partners, recruiters, cross-functional leadership, and executives). Communications excellence across a wide dynamic range, both written and verbal. Experience interfacing with company leadership and executives is a must, with a demonstrated ability to cultivate trust, facilitate meetings for, and engage with executives.

 Technically minded — Solid technical aptitude and proven ability to understand technical designs, and the ability to work closely and effectively with engineering teams.

 Bridges operational and analytical teams — Strong emotional intelligence and ability to solve operational problems in a way that is both data-driven and people-centric.

 High ownership and capacity — Horsepower to effectively manage multiple (6+) large projects and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.

 Finance literate — Comfortable owning a bottom line, reading and acting on P&L, budget, and margin data in partnership with FP&A.

 Ability to work onsite five days a week at either our Reston, VA office or our HQ in Costa Mesa, CA.

 Minimum 25% travel expected.

 Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 MBA or similar degree.

 Experience working with engineers and bringing hardware/software products to market strongly preferred.

 Experience in the intelligence community or national security mission space

 Experience leading a business operations, business analytics, or similar function

 Experience working effectively in a matrix organization structure.

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related field.

 US Salary Range
 $183,000 — $243,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

source.description:
At **QXO**, our **Branch Managers** are business leaders responsible for driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and talent development across their locations. This role goes far beyond day-to-day branch oversight. Branch Managers own the financial performance of the business, lead teams through growth and transformation, and partner closely with cross-functional leaders to deliver exceptional results for customers, employees, and shareholders. The ideal candidate combines strong business and financial acumen with exceptional leadership capability. They understand how to manage a P&L, optimize operations, build high-performing teams, execute strategic initiatives, and lead effectively through change in a fast-paced environment.

* Lead all aspects of branch performance, including sales, operations, customer service, inventory, safety, and profitability
* Own branch P&L performance and drive sustainable revenue growth, margin expansion, expense management, and return on investment
* Analyze financial, operational, and market performance data to identify opportunities, address risks, and make informed business decisions
* Develop and execute local business strategies aligned with company objectives and growth initiatives
* Build, coach, and develop high-performing teams while creating a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement
* Lead organizational change initiatives and help teams successfully navigate evolving business priorities, systems, and processes
* Partner closely with Sales, HR, EHS, FP&A, Credit, Supply Chain, Operations, and other Centers of Excellence to achieve business objectives
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with customers, vendors, and community stakeholders
* Drive operational excellence through disciplined execution, productivity improvements, inventory optimization, and process standardization
* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and operational standards
* Identify and develop future leaders through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and talent development initiatives
* Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and customer needs to uncover opportunities for growth and market share expansion

**What you'll earn:**

* 401(k) with employer match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
* Paid training and certifications
* Legal assistance and identity protection
* Pet insurance
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

**QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer**. It is the policy of the Company to comply with all employment laws and to afford equal employment opportunity to individuals in all aspects of employment, including in selection for job opportunities, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, protected veteran status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance submitting an application or would like to request an accommodation, please email us at careers@QXO.com to make a request.

QXO, Inc. (NYSE: QXO) is the largest publicly traded distributor of roofing, waterproofing, and related products, and the second largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials in North America. QXO is the fastest growing company in the $800 billion building products distribution industry and plans to become the tech-enabled leader by delivering best-in-class customer satisfaction and outsized returns for its shareholders. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenues within the next decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth.

source.description:
Job Description

Posting Start Date: 11/17/26

Offer ID: 2814

Unit: HM Clause

**Job Title:** **Plant manager**
================================

Job Location: Modesto, USA

Contract type: Permanent

Job Description:

**Company Introduction**
------------------------

#### ***“WE BUILD TRUST WITH FARMERS AROUND THE WORLD BY SUPPORTING THEM TO SUSTAINABLY IMPROVE THE QUALITY AND FLAVOR OF THEIR PRODUCTION.”***

 

**HM.CLAUSE** is a Business Unit of **Limagrain** , an international agricultural co-operative founded and managed by farmers. **HM.CLAUSE** specializes in the breeding, production, and sale of vegetable seeds. From the world market to the farmer's market, we collaborate with our customers to deliver successful solutions for the agricultural challenges of today and produce the highest quality vegetable seeds for the future. Our global team of experts and state-of-the-art research facilities enable us to work side-by-side with growers to provide the most regionally relevant and reliable vegetable seeds available.

 

*If our mission resonates with your passion, we look forward to your application.*

**Job description**
-------------------

**You will be a great fit if you have experience similar to:**

Manufacturing Leadership
 

* Lead all manufacturing operations to deliver SQCDME objectives.
* Define annual operational priorities, targets and improvement roadmaps.
* Ensure production plans are achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and service.
* Monitor plant performance through KPIs, visual management systems and operational reviews.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives across all manufacturing areas.
* Develop and maintain adequate organizational structures supporting current and future business needs.
* Ensure effective deployment of corporate manufacturing programs and standards.
* Lead crisis management and business continuity activities impacting manufacturing operations.
* Support S&OP execution and capacity planning processes to ensure alignment between demand and manufacturing capability.
* Develop and execute productivity, efficiency and waste reduction programs.

Safety, Quality and Compliance
 

* Ensure all manufacturing activities comply with company standards, local regulations and applicable legal requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture through visible leadership, employee engagement and accountability.
* Ensure completion and continuous improvement of Job Safety Analyses (JSA), risk assessments, safety tours and safety programs.
* Lead investigations related to safety, quality or environmental incidents affecting manufacturing operations.
* Ensure quality systems, procedures, audits and corrective actions are effectively deployed and sustained.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of findings.
* Ensure manufacturing operations comply with all environmental obligations and permit requirements.

People Leadership
 

* Recruit, develop, coach and retain manufacturing talent.
* Conduct performance reviews and succession planning for key positions.
* Lead regular one-on-one meetings with direct reports.
* Foster employee engagement, teamwork, accountability and continuous learning.
* Support implementation of organizational changes and transformation projects.
* Promote company values and leadership principles throughout the organization.

Financial and Asset Management
 

* Prepare, manage and control the manufacturing operating budget.
* Develop and monitor annual OPEX and CAPEX plans.
* Build business cases and investment proposals supporting business growth and operational improvements.
* Ensure efficient utilization of labor, equipment and material resources.
* Drive initiatives focused on productivity, cost optimization and financial performance improvement.
* Monitor departmental spending and ensure compliance with approved budgets.

**Job Description Continued**
-----------------------------

Site Management Responsibilities
 

* Serve as the primary site representative toward regulatory agencies, government authorities and external stakeholders.
* Ensure all site permits, authorizations and regulatory requirements remain compliant and up to date.
* Coordinate site-wide activities between Manufacturing, Laboratory, Administrative functions and Facilities.
* Chair or coordinate the site leadership governance process.
* Ensure proper site infrastructure, facility maintenance and utilities management in partnership with Facilities.
* Lead site emergency preparedness and crisis management processes.
* Ensure security programs and site access controls are maintained and effective.
* Coordinate site safety matters affecting common areas and shared services.
* Promote collaboration and alignment among all site functions to ensure overall site performance and compliance.
* Support sustainability and environmental improvement initiatives across the site.

Communication and Leadership
 

* Lead plant leadership meetings and performance reviews.
* Ensure effective communication of business objectives, priorities and results.
* Maintain strong relationships with corporate functions including Supply Chain, Quality, HR, Finance, EHS, Engineering and Commercial teams.
* Participate actively in regional and global operations forums.
* Provide timely reporting to senior leadership regarding operational performance, risks and opportunities.

**To be considered, you will need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, Manufacturing, Operations Management or related field.
* MBA or equivalent business qualification preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of manufacturing or industrial operations experience.
* Minimum 5 years of leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and operational budgets.
* Experience with regulatory compliance, environmental management and site governance preferred

**Your benefits and working environment**
-----------------------------------------

**The rewards of working here:** You join an expert team of innovators and creators that collaborate with farmers around the world to sustainably enhance the taste and quality of healthy food. Our goal is to form teams that inspire and learn from each other as they work to elevate our products from seed to table. We recognize our employees as our most valued resource and work to create an atmosphere that is supportive, healthy, and progressive. We promote an environment of wellness and well-being and hybrid schedules when it is appropriate for the position. It is an important and expanding piece of our local and global mission for Diversity & Inclusion programs and support groups in the corporate world.

 

HM.CLAUSE offers a strong compensation and benefits package to its employees:

* Competitive salary
* + This position’s range is **$116,000 - $146,000**

Our total compensation and pay ranges reflect our market pay structures. As such, individual salaries or hourly rates are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: local geographical market conditions, internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as job related skills, education, and experience.

* Comprehensive Benefits Choices
* + Medical, Dental, Vision
* Work/Life Balance
* + 12 Paid Holidays per year
 + +1 Floating Holiday per year
 + Paid shutdown holidays
 + Progressive time off starting at 80-vacation hours
* Company Covered Benefits
* + Company paid Life Insurance, Long and Short-Term Disability
* Wellness Benefits
* + Family EAP, Telehealth and Mental Wellness Services
* Internal Career Progression
* + Learning Environment
 + Promotions from within
 + Paid Annual Training
 + Tuition Reimbursement
* Welcoming Environment
* + Business casual attire; open door policy
* Financial Wellness
* + 401(k) dollar for dollar Employer matching
 + Supplemental Employer Contribution Plan
 + Traditional and Roth (401k) plans options
 + Company Profit sharing in December
* Family Benefits
* + Maternity and Paternity paid time off
 + Low family medical deductibles
 + Family Planning Resources

We are a company with a supportive culture and leadership. We encourage you to be part of our journey to enhance the world’s food supply and support the farmers that grow them.

 

To view all U.S. based privacy rights and how to exercise them, click here: Privacy policy - HM Clause .

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

**The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.**

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands and fingers to handle and feel. The employee is regularly required to use office equipment and computers. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 70 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

source.description:
**SCOPE OF POSITION:** 
Directs the strategic oversight and continuous improvement of the organization’s manufacturing Quality Management System (QMS) to achieve operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

 

**CONSTRUCTION SPECIALTIES, INC.**

Founded in 1948, Construction Specialties (CS) is a specialty building products manufacturer. CS provides solutions to building challenges that architects, designers, building owners, facility managers, and contractors face every day. Since inventing the first extruded louver, CS has become a global leader in all our product categories. Our products are a part of some of the most iconic buildings around the world– from the world’s tallest tower, Burj Khalifa in Dubai, to the Oculus at the World Trade Center Transit Hub in Manhattan. If you want to work in an inspiring atmosphere and collaborate with customers and colleagues to solve challenges, we're the right place for you. CS: People. Buildings. Better.

 

*Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans.*

 

**KNOWLEDGE/ SKILLS/ EXPERIENCE/ EDUCATION:** (Minimum Education and/or Experience required)

* Strong leadership and team-building skills, strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent preferred.
* 6 years in QMS leadership with demonstrated experience leading a quality system.
* Managing and Leading through Influence
* Ability to travel up to 50%
 

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Problem Solving
* Process Improvement
* Quality Assurance Process
* Total Quality Management (TQM)
* Strategic Planning
* Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)
Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Processes 

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* yes

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, including but not necessarily limited to the following:*

* Develop, maintain and optimize global QMS strategy and processes based on relevant regulatory requirements and aligned with corporate goals.
* Establishes quality governance frameworks, performance metrics, and audit systems to monitor compliance and drive consistent process improvement.
* Partners with senior leadership to integrate quality objectives into overall business planning and customer satisfaction initiatives.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing QMS team. Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and collaboration within the team and across the organization.

source.title: Plant Manager
source.description:
The role of the Plant Manager is to coordinate and direct production activity through the manufacturing processes while meeting company production, quality, safety and profitability goals. In addition, the Plant Manager will apply the principles of Lean Manufacturing to direct the workforce in promoting a continuous improvement atmosphere and culture.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES and TASKS**

* Coordinate production activities for hourly employees and related salaried staff insuring all manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a timely and cost effective manner.
* Control and minimize labor overtime.
* Maintain Production Schedules and Quality Standards
* Ensure effective utilization of MRP system throughout process
* Recognize and solve problems affecting production, quality, safety and productivity.
* Apply the tools of Lean Manufacturing .
* Minimize attrition through effective hiring and coaching practices.
* Foster a culture of empowerment so that all levels of employees are engaged in continuous improvement activities.
* Help implement and maintain preventative maintenance programs. Make recommendations for facilities and equipment when necessary.
* Incorporate shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.

* Provide direction, development and leadership to production employees through performance management tools.
* Provide effective communication to support the needs of the employees as well as the goals of the organization.
* Actively engage in all Safety initiatives to meet or exceed EH&S goals and plans.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS and EDUCATION**

* BSIE or BSME
* Minimum 8 years in manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures
* Minimum 5 years in supervisors/management position
* Strong background in MRP systems, preferably Microsoft AX that includes expertise with Material Bills, Routings and Work Standards.
* Proven success in large scale process improvement initiatives within manufacturing environment and cross functional teams
* Training in Lean Manufacturing, TPS, and Demand Flow
* Exceptional communication and proven leadership skills

**SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, LICENSES, CERTIFICATIONS, ETC:**

* Competent in Microsoft Office including Word, Excel and Outlook

### **PHYSICAL EFFORT**

* Ability to sit, stand, walk intermittently for 8 hours.
* Ability to work on a PC as required.

source.title: Director, Operations - CAM - CCM
source.description:
**Company Description**

Carlisle Companies is a leading manufacturer of building envelope products and solutions that make buildings more energy efficient, durable, and sustainable.

We deliver roofing, insulation, waterproofing, and architectural systems for commercial and residential projects using a focus on innovation and continuous improvement to solve today’s challenges.

We’re equally committed to our people, prioritizing safety, inclusion, career growth development, tuition assistance, and excellent benefits.

With manufacturing, engineering, R&D, and corporate functions across North America and globally, Carlisle offers stability, agility, and opportunity in a performance-driven culture. Do meaningful work and shape the future of building solutions; apply today and come grow with us.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary:**

Manage long-term manufacturing strategies and support day-to-day operational activities across the Edge Manufacturing Region within the Carlisle Architectural Metals (CAM) business unit. Ensure all facilities within the assigned region follow manufacturing best practices related to safety, quality, delivery, and cost. Lead teams with mutual trust, respect, and integrity while supporting profitable growth through operational efficiencies, continuous improvement, and cost reduction initiatives.

Facilities currently assigned to the region include Arden, NC, and Waukesha, WI. The scope of responsibility may change over time and is not limited to the facilities listed, as additional locations may be assigned based on evolving business needs.

Work Location: This role is listed as remote; however, it is preferred to be near one of the two Edge sites.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Drive results and regularly review metrics relating to Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost.
* Lead and mentor Plant Managers in achieving business targets and financial metrics.
* Support companies’ Lean initiatives (Carlisle Operating System) - to include Strategic projects, MDI, 5S, TPM, kaizen and best practice sharing amongst plants.
* Collaborate with sales, demand/supply planning, engineering, safety, quality, and other cross functional teams to proactively develop company-wide manufacturing product and service solutions.
* Drive consistency in structure and operational practices across recent acquisitions and as acquisitions of like businesses are made.
* Champion annual efforts to build the CAM operating and capital budgets.
* Responsible for analyzing technology, resource needs, and market demand to plan and assess the feasibility of company projects.
* Ensure facilities are following all OSHA and company required safety programs, policies, and practices, including but not limited to those activities to fully engage all team members.
* Ensure facilities safely follow all environmental rules in compliance with federal, state, and local laws and share best practices across the organization.
* Interview, hire, and facilitate training for additions to the operations leadership team.
* Provide regular performance updates to the senior leadership team.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Partitioner of Lean Manufacturing Concepts and Tools.
* Familiarity with plant processes, machinery, and maintenance, and lean manufacturing tools and concepts.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills including presentation, respectful debate, and meeting facilitation.
* Effective project, people, process, and budget management, hiring a skilled team, setting strategy for a large and diverse team.
* Effective Leadership through setting expectations and holding people accountable through appropriate praise and discipline.
* Ability to quickly gain input, make decisions, and assure alignment.
* Effective verbal and written communications
* Ability to effectively present to large groups.

* Analyze P&L or budget reports to assess business health and identify improvement opportunities.
* Create and maintain relationships with supporting departments, sales groups and various material and equipment suppliers.
* Team oriented and trusted leader.
* Performance Assessment, Feedback and Accountability.

**Education and Experience:**

* Required:
 + Bachelor’s Degree in an Engineering or Technical discipline with strong business focus. Masters preferred.
 + 7+ years of managing plant operations
 - Preferred: Experience with multi-site leadership
 + Strong analytical skills and strong working knowledge of data analysis.
 + Strong transferable knowledge of lean principles and continuous improvement tools.
 + Strong safety orientation and ability to hold team accountable.
 + Proven and effective decision-making skills.
 + Demonstrated ability to plan and manage operational processes for maximum efficiency and productivity.
 + Shown ability to set strategy and lead a large diverse team.
 + Solid communication skills both verbal and written.
 + Experience in integrating acquisitions a plus (but not required)

 **Additional Information**

**Working Conditions:**

* Primarily office-based, with regular exposure to manufacturing and production environments across multiple facilities.
* Standard business hours are Monday through Friday, with flexibility required to support operational and business needs.
* Additional hours, including evenings and weekends, may be necessary based on business demands and operational priorities.
* Approximately 40% travel required to support facility operations, business meetings, training, and other organizational needs.

**Physical Requirements:**

According to ADA regulations, reasonable accommodation will be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Frequency scale:** Occasionally (0–30%) | Frequently (31–60%) | Continuously (61–100%)

**LIFTING OR CARRYING**

* 1–10 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 11–20 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 21–40 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 41–50 LBS —**Occasionally**
* 51 OR MORE LBS — **Occasionally**

**PUSHING OR PULLING:**

* 1–40 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 41–50 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 51 OR MORE LBS — **Occasionally**

**OTHER PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* BENDING OR STOOPING — **Occasionally**
* REACHING ABOVE SHOULDER LEVEL — **Occasionally**

* DRIVING AUTOMATIC EQUIP. VEHICLES — **Occasionally**
* OPERATE MACHINERY OR POWER TOOLS — **Occasionally**
* CLIMBING (LADDERS, STAIRS, ETC.) —**Occasionally**

* WALKING — **Occasionally**
* STANDING — **Occasionally**
* SITTING — **Occasionally**
* WORKING IN EXTREME TEMPERATURES — **Occasionally**

* REPETTIVE MOTION INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO: WRISTS, HANDS AND/OR FINGERS) — **Occasionally**
* VISION — **Occasionally**
* HEARING — **Occasionally**
* DEXTERITY — **Occasionally**
* HAND EYE COORDINATION — **Occasionally**

**Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Used:**

* Eye protection is required on the production floor.
* Safety toe shoes (steel/composite) on the production floor.
* Other PPE as defined by management.

The employee is expected to comply with all company policies related to data security, confidentiality, and remote work standards.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We endeavor to make this site accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact careers@carlisle.com.

**INFORMATION SECURITY ALERT**

All applicants for careers with Carlisle will be submitted through this site. Carlisle will not extend job offers without prior in-person or visual correspondence and we will not ask you to provide private personal information for a background check prior to extending a job offer. For more information, please review our Privacy policy.

source.title: Precision CNC Operations Director
source.description:
**Own the rhythm of a high-precision machine shop**
---------------------------------------------------

Our client is seeking a seasoned leader to run day-to-day CNC operations in a precision manufacturing environment. You’ll guide a 30-person team of operators and engineers, elevate throughput and first-pass yield, and embed continuous improvement across the floor. Compensation: $120K–$135K.

### **What a typical day looks like**

* Walk the floor, review KPIs, and align the team to production and quality targets.
* Prioritize jobs and resources across multi-axis CNC milling, turning, and grinding centers.
* Coach and develop talent—delegating, mentoring, and building a strong pipeline of leaders.
* Tune workflows, tooling, and setups to reduce changeover time and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Advance CI initiatives using CAD/CAM optimizations and in-process probing strategies.
* Coordinate closely with engineering and quality to resolve issues at root cause.
* Manage inventory and material flow to keep schedules on track with ERP visibility.
* Ensure adherence to ISO 9001 requirements and reinforce a strong safety culture.

### **What you bring**

* Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Proven leadership managing teams in a CNC machining environment.
* Deep CNC expertise across milling, turning, and grinding operations.
* Fluency with ERP systems and modern CAD/CAM toolchains.

If you’re energized by precision, people leadership, and measurable impact, this role gives you the platform to drive results every day.

source.title: Sr Director, Fulfillment and Distribution Center Operations
source.description:
Why Join ADI?

At ADI, our distribution network is much more than a collection of warehouses. It is a critical competitive advantage and one of the primary drivers of our customer experience. As the Senior Director of Distribution Center Operations, you will lead a geographically dispersed network of distribution centers that serves thousands of customers across North America. This role is responsible for ensuring every facility operates safely, efficiently, and consistently while delivering exceptional service levels that support our branches, sales teams, and customers. This is a highly visible leadership position that sits at the intersection of Operations, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Sales, Finance, Human Resources, and Digital Transformation. You will shape the future of ADI's distribution network through operational excellence, continuous improvement, technology adoption, workforce engagement, and strategic network initiatives. We're looking for a leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, embraces complex operational challenges, and understands that every shipment, every inventory decision, and every associate interaction ultimately impacts the customer experience.

**Job Description**

What You'll Own

* Lead all aspects of distribution center operations across ADI's North American network, ensuring safe, scalable, and customer-focused execution.
* Establish a culture where safety, engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement are foundational expectations.
* Drive network performance across key operational metrics including service levels, productivity, quality, inventory accuracy, fulfillment speed, receiving performance, and cost efficiency.
* Partner closely with Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Merchandising, and Digital Transformation teams to improve customer experience and deliver industry leading service. • Develop and execute strategies that improve operational performance while supporting long-term business growth.
* Lead and develop a team of distribution center leaders, creating a high performance culture built on accountability, talent development, and succession planning.
* Ensure staffing, labor planning, equipment strategies, and capacity models to support current and future business requirements.
* Champion Business Excellence principles across the network while driving sustainable process standardization and continuous improvement programs.
* Lead large-scale operational transformation initiatives, including warehouse management systems, automation, labor optimization, and process redesign projects.
* Partner on network optimization initiatives including facility expansion, consolidation, new site implementation, and network design strategy.
* Drive best-in-class inventory management practices that improve inventory accuracy while supporting customer service and working capital objectives.
* Utilize operational data, analytics, and technology to identify opportunities to improve service, productivity, quality, and cost performance.
* Develop and manage operating budgets, capital investment plans, and long-range operational strategies.
* Build strong relationships with key suppliers, equipment providers, transportation partners, and service organizations that support distribution operations.
* Serve as a senior operational leader during periods of rapid growth, supply disruption, major business initiatives, and peak-volume events.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customers receive the right product at the right time with exceptional consistency.
* Distribution centers operate safely while maintaining world-class productivity and quality.
* Inventory accuracy supports both customer satisfaction and strong financial performance.
* Teams are engaged, developed, and empowered to solve problems at the source.
* The network continuously evolves through automation, technology, and process improvement.
* ADI maintains a scalable distribution platform capable of supporting future growth.

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 10+ years of progressive distribution, fulfillment, logistics, or supply chain leadership experience.
* Experience leading multi-site distribution operations within a complex, high-volume network.
* Demonstrated success managing large teams through multiple layers of leadership.
* Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory management, labor planning, transportation, and fulfillment processes.
* Experience driving significant operational improvements across productivity, service, quality, safety, and cost metrics.
* Experience leading large-scale change initiatives including WMS implementations, network transformations, automation projects, or facility start-ups.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing operating budgets, labor plans, and capital investments.
* Proven ability to build cross-functional partnerships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Willingness to travel regularly throughout the distribution network.

**WE VALUE**

* Experience in change management and creating buy-in.
* Enjoyment from being collaborative and hands-on; comfortable balancing tactical execution with strategic initiatives.
* A leadership style with continuous improvement at its core.
* A history of thriving in a fast-paced and often ambiguous environment.
* A self-starter personality who maps their own direction to succeed.

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Be a part of the #1 Global Distribution Team
* Leverage your expertise to build and improve ADI's culture and processes.
* Benefits Day 1, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays.

source.description:
Job description:

Job Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Operations Manager to lead and optimize daily store operations, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers and a motivating environment for team members. This role requires a proactive leader with strong management skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for retail excellence. As an Operations Manager, you will oversee all aspects of store functions, from sales and customer service to inventory control and staff supervision, driving operational efficiency and sales growth.

Duties

* Lead and manage the retail team, including hiring, training, coaching, and developing staff to achieve high performance standards.
* Oversee daily store operations such as cash handling, POS system management, merchandising, stocking, and inventory control to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
* Implement effective sales strategies by managing pricing, promotions, and product placement to maximize revenue.
* Supervise shift management activities, including scheduling, task delegation, and ensuring excellent customer service at all times.
* Conduct employee orientation sessions, interviews for new hires, and ongoing training to foster a knowledgeable and motivated team.
* Manage purchasing decisions, vendor relations, and inventory replenishment to maintain optimal stock levels while controlling costs.
* Enforce safety protocols, manage payroll processing, bookkeeping tasks, and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Utilize management skills to analyze sales data, prepare budgets, monitor expenses, and identify opportunities for operational improvements.

Experience

* Proven managerial experience in retail store management or a similar leadership role within the retail industry.
* Demonstrated success in supervising sales teams with a focus on retail sales management and customer service excellence.
* Strong background in inventory management, POS systems operation, merchandising, and cash handling procedures.
* Experience in recruiting, interviewing, onboarding new employees, and conducting training & development initiatives.
* Knowledge of retail math including pricing strategies, budgeting techniques, and basic financial analysis.
* Bilingual or multilingual skills are highly desirable to effectively communicate with diverse customer bases.
* Previous experience with grocery or wireless sales environments is a plus; familiarity with retail industry standards is essential.

Join us as an Operations Manager to lead with energy and purpose! Your leadership will inspire your team to deliver outstanding customer experiences while driving operational success. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments — if you’re passionate about retail management and ready to make an impact, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $80,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person

source.title: Operations Director - Healthcare
source.description:
**Operations Director**
=======================

**Lead the Team. Drive Growth. Make an Impact.**
------------------------------------------------

Aveanna Healthcare is seeking an experienced and motivated **Operations Director (OD)** to lead the overall operations, growth, and performance of one of our locations.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys developing teams, and knows how to balance **people, performance, growth, and operational excellence**.

As the Operations Director, you’ll serve as the leader of your branch, partnering closely with clinical, operational, recruiting, and business development teams to ensure we deliver exceptional care while meeting growth and financial goals.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead & Develop Your Team**

* Lead, coach, and support a high-performing branch team.
* Recruit and retain qualified staff.
* Establish goals, monitor performance, and complete timely performance evaluations.
* Promote employee development, accountability, and strong communication.
* Partner with area and regional leadership to keep branch priorities aligned with organizational goals.

### **Drive Branch Growth**

* Develop and implement strategies to grow the business and expand patient services.
* Maintain a strong sense of urgency around referrals, admissions, and start-of-care timelines.
* Partner with business development and referral sources to strengthen relationships and identify growth opportunities.
* Monitor the referral pipeline and address barriers that could delay patient care.

### **Build Strong Relationships**

* Develop trusted relationships with patients, families, caregivers, referral partners, and community partners.
* Support patient introductions and periodic home visits when needed.
* Follow up on satisfaction surveys and identify opportunities to improve the patient and caregiver experience.
* Serve as an advocate and trusted leader for your branch team.

### **Own Operational & Financial Performance**

* Monitor branch performance, staffing, productivity, revenue, billing, collections, and expenses.
* Review financial statements and operational reports to identify trends and opportunities.
* Identify ways to improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary costs, and strengthen branch performance.
* Oversee caregiver staffing and ensure service delivery expectations are consistently met.

### **Maintain Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure the branch operates in accordance with company policies, payor requirements, and applicable state and federal regulations.
* Partner with clinical leadership to address quality concerns and implement corrective actions when necessary.
* Monitor key performance indicators to identify risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Promote a culture centered on accountability, compliance, service excellence, and quality patient care.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Associate degree or equivalent related work experience required.
* 2–3 years of management or leadership experience.
* Strong leadership and staff-development skills.
* Excellent communication, organization, and time-management abilities.
* Ability to make confident decisions and solve problems in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
* Ability to remain professional and composed in challenging situations.
* Must meet all applicable state requirements, including background checks and work authorization requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Healthcare leadership or operations experience.
* Pediatric or home healthcare experience.

**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------

* Ability to travel as needed.
* Ability to work in a variety of home and healthcare environments.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries at all times.
* Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand English.
* Must meet the physical requirements necessary to perform the essential functions of the position.

**Why This Role?**
------------------

The Operations Director is more than a branch management position. You’ll have the opportunity to **build a strong team, grow the business, strengthen community relationships, and directly influence the quality of care provided to patients and families.**

If you’re a results-driven leader who enjoys developing people, solving problems, and taking ownership of business performance, this could be the next step in your career.

**Vaccination Requirements**
----------------------------

As an employer accepting Medicare and Medicaid funds, employees must comply with applicable health-related requirements in relevant jurisdictions, including required vaccinations and testing, subject to appropriate medical or religious exemptions.

*This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive listing of all duties, responsibilities, or activities required of the position. Responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.*

source.title: VP Operations
source.description:
Daubert Chemical Company is seeking a Vice President of Operations at our specialty chemical plant near Midway airport. The VP leads the functional areas of chemical production, customer service, supply chain, engineering, maintenance and reliability, and EHS. The VP of Operations is a member of the executive team reporting to the CEO, and is accountable for achieving safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting product quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements. This leader will establish clear performance and behavioral expectations, execute with the appropriate sense of urgency, develop organizational capabilities, and drive accountability across all operational functions.
 
 
The successful candidate will balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategic planning, continuous improvement and corrective action programs, ensuring that plant equipment, processes, systems, and people are positioned to support business growth and operational excellence.
 
 
This position requires a hands-on, visible leader who demonstrates sound judgment, urgency, follow-up, disciplined problem-solving, and a commitment to improvement and resolution of issues via a methodical corrective action program. The VP of Operations must effectively lead through others, collaborate across departments, and develop sustainable solutions that improve safety, productivity, reliability, product quality, waste reduction, and regulatory compliance.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
include, but not limited to the following.
 
 

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of functional managers and operational leaders, establishing clear responsibilities, performance standards, and accountability. Build leadership capability at all levels through coaching, performance feedback, succession planning, and professional development
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, technical competencies, and resource requirements to ensure effective operational support
* Lead operational decision-making with a strong sense of urgency, appropriate prioritization, and consideration of safety, quality, cost, and customer impact
* Develop and manage departmental operating budgets, control expenditures, evaluate variances, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance
* Collaborate with Sales, R&D, IT, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and other functions to align operational capabilities with business requirements
* Provide leadership to production management to optimize plant capacity, equipment utilization, labor resources, product mix, and material availability
* Develop and ensure execution of a long-range capital investment plan; provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant engineering, equipment performance, reliability initiatives, and capital improvement projects that align with business priorities and integrate safety and environmental considerations
* Direct the team in the development and effectiveness of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs
* Provide executive oversight of EHS programs and ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, state, local, and other regulatory requirements
* Support effective safety inspections, regulatory audits, incident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk-reduction initiatives
* Champion the use of structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, 5S, and other appropriate improvement methodologies
* Foster a culture of respect, teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and personal accountability.
* Demonstrate and reinforce the company's Core Values: Reliable, Improving, Fair, and Caring

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
Directly manages functional leaders. Performs managerial responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws, such as recruitment, selection, training, goals, performance expectations and accountability, compensation management.
 
 
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; Chemical Engineering strongly preferred. MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years leading managers and multiple operational functions
* Significant leadership experience in specialty chemical manufacturing, batch processing, or a comparable process manufacturing environment strongly preferred
* Demonstrated responsibility for managing and improving cost optimization with a multi-million-dollar operational budget in manufacturing operations, engineering, maintenance, equipment reliability, capital projects, and resource allocation
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment with strong safety, environmental, and process compliance requirements.

source.title: Director of Manufacturing
source.description:
**About the Opportunity**

CoreWise is partnering with a growing industrial equipment manufacturer to identify a
**Director of Manufacturing**
who can lead its manufacturing operations through the next phase of growth.

Our client designs and manufactures complex, engineered-to-order industrial equipment. As production demands increase, the company is looking for an experienced manufacturing leader who can build strong teams, improve operational performance, and establish the processes and structure needed to scale.

This is an opportunity for someone who understands how to grow a manufacturing operation without sacrificing safety, quality, or workmanship.

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Vice President of Manufacturing, the
**Director of Manufacturing**
will oversee daily manufacturing operations across multiple production departments, with responsibility for production performance, labor efficiency, quality, safety, and workforce development.

We're looking for a leader who is just as comfortable on the manufacturing floor as they are developing operational strategy. Someone who understands how to identify bottlenecks, develop frontline leaders, establish accountability, and translate business objectives into measurable results.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead Manufacturing Operations**

* Oversee daily manufacturing operations, production schedules, capacity planning, and labor utilization to meet production and customer delivery commitments.
* Lead and develop production managers, supervisors, and department leaders.
* Establish clear performance expectations and consistent production standards across departments.
* Improve coordination between production teams to maintain workflow and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Plan and implement multi-shift operations as production demands increase.

**Improve Operational Performance**

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase throughput, improve labor efficiency, reduce costs, and expand manufacturing capacity.
* Establish and monitor manufacturing KPIs, including production output, labor efficiency, schedule attainment, rework, and on-time delivery.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement sustainable solutions.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies to standardize processes and improve performance.
* Develop scalable manufacturing processes that support long-term business growth.

**Build and Develop Strong Teams**

* Coach and develop manufacturing managers and supervisors to become effective, independent leaders.
* Establish a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and quality workmanship.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, staffing, succession planning, and employee development.
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, and supervisory coverage to meet operational needs.
* Set clear expectations for productivity, attendance, performance, and adherence to company policies.

**Champion Safety and Quality**

* Maintain a safe manufacturing environment in compliance with OSHA regulations, company policies, and applicable industry standards.
* Partner with Quality and Safety teams to reduce defects, rework, incidents, and operational risks.
* Ensure manufactured products consistently meet engineering specifications, quality standards, and customer requirements.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective actions to prevent recurring production and quality issues.

**Manage Manufacturing Costs and Resources**

* Manage labor costs, overtime, productivity, and resource utilization.
* Partner with Finance and executive leadership on manufacturing budgets, capital expenditures, and cost-control initiatives.
* Evaluate equipment, facility, workforce, and technology needs to support increased production.
* Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing profitability through process improvements and effective resource allocation.

**Support Business Growth**

* Work closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Project Management, Human Resources, and Finance to align manufacturing priorities.
* Address material availability, production readiness, and technical challenges that impact manufacturing performance.
* Support facility expansions, production transitions, and new product introductions.
* Provide executive leadership with regular updates on manufacturing performance, operational risks, and opportunities for improvement.

**What You'll Bring**

* At least 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including a minimum of 5 years in a senior management or director-level role.
* Experience leading large-scale manufacturing operations with multiple production departments, managers, and supervisors.
* A demonstrated track record of improving production output, labor productivity, operational efficiency, and manufacturing performance.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, capacity management, manufacturing cost controls, and operational KPIs.
* Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement initiatives, and standardized production processes.
* Experience with ERP systems and manufacturing reporting tools.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, growing manufacturing environment.
* A bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Experience in engineered-to-order manufacturing, industrial equipment, HVAC, electrical integration, or other complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience overseeing multi-shift manufacturing operations.
* Technical familiarity with mechanical and electrical assembly, fabrication, and equipment testing.
* Experience scaling manufacturing operations during periods of significant growth.
* Experience supporting facility expansions, operational restructuring, or manufacturing transformations.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or related continuous improvement training.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Production and on-time delivery targets are consistently met.
* Manufacturing capacity and labor productivity improve.
* Rework, defects, and production inefficiencies decrease.
* Safety standards are upheld throughout the manufacturing operation.
* Production managers and supervisors take ownership of their teams and performance.
* Labor and manufacturing costs are effectively managed as production grows.
* Manufacturing processes are established that support sustainable, long-term growth.

**About CoreWise**

CoreWise is a recruiting and workforce strategy partner that connects talented professionals with growing organizations. We are managing this search on behalf of our client and will work directly with qualified candidates throughout the recruiting process.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Our client is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

source.title: Director Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing
source.description:
**Build Our Future Together**
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Regeneron is currently looking for a Director of Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing to join our Industrial Operations and Product Supply (IOPS) team. This leadership role is accountable for the aseptic filling operation for clinical and commercial drug products, including vials and syringes in both liquid and lyophilized formats. The Director owns the full filling value stream: materials management; preparation of equipment, format parts, and components; formulation of drug product and placebo; aseptic filling; and lyophilization. The Director also ensures a seamless handoff to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, syringe safety systems and autoinjector assembly, packaging, labeling, and serialization) and oversees facility cleaning and contamination control for the filling suites.
 
 
This role focuses on the start-up and execution of compliant GMP aseptic operations, ensuring the facility is properly staffed and trained, and supporting a dynamic, flexible production planning process that meets the needs of Regenerons patients. The Director will work directly with Drug Substance and Finish manufacturing management to ensure production timelines are met and will be a key member of various management teams within IOPS.
 
 
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
 
 
**When & Where**
Location: Rensselaer, NY
 
 
Work model: Monday- Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 
 
**Discover Your Role**
Provides leadership, vision, and management to the Filling team and its supporting functions, and leads all aspects of Filling operations at the facility to manufacture commercial and clinical parenteral medicines according to approved protocols, regulations, and schedules
 
 
Directly oversees aseptic filling of drug product and placebo into vials and syringes, in liquid and lyophilized formats, including stoppering, capping, and crimping
 
 
Directly oversees formulation of bulk drug product and placebo, including solution preparation and sterile filtration
 
 
Directly oversees preparation of equipment, format parts, and components to support aseptic filling, including washing, depyrogenation, sterilization, and setup of filling lines
 
 
Directly oversees lyophilization operations, including loading, cycle execution, and unloading, as well as the management of materials and components required to support filling operations
 
 
Directly oversees cleaning and sanitization of filling suites, including Graded space (Grade AD) and Controlled Non-Classified rooms (iCNC), and supports the site contamination control strategy, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulations (media fills)
 
 
Ensures a smooth, timely handoff of filled product to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, assembly, packaging, and labeling) in partnership with the leaders of those areas
 
 
Troubleshoots and resolves issues impeding filling deliverables, including equipment performance, line interventions, and yield; provides technical input to resolve filling and aseptic process challenges
 
 
Partners with department Directors and Project Management to implement new filling processes, including new formats, PFS and vial filling lines, formulation, aseptic filling, and lyophilization
 
 
Manages department metrics and goals, monitors performance to objectives, and drives continuous improvement initiatives essential to meeting patient and business needs
 
 
Leads the annual merit performance review process, builds departmental structure, and develops long-term staffing plans, including aseptic gowning qualification and training programs
 
 
Collaborates with department Directors to support development of the annual budget, and rapidly and accurately communicates issues to department Directors
 
 
Writes, reviews, and/or approves Standard Operating Procedures, specifications, regulatory filings, or other controlled documents as needed
 
 
Executes Quality Management System assignments (CAPA, Deviation, Investigation, Change Control, etc.)
 
 
Participates in the development and maintenance of a safe manufacturing environment and ensures that IOPS safety standards are maintained
 
 
Oversees, supports, and participates in cGMP audits of all filling areas within the facility; maintains site inspection readiness and represents the filling operation during regulatory and client audits
 
 
**This Role Requires**
BS in any of the physical or biological sciences or chemical engineering, with biopharmaceutical/biotech experience in a GMP drug product production facility, including aseptic filling experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experienceDirector: 12+ years of experience
 
 
Senior Director: 15+ years of experience
 
 
Level will be determined based on experience
 
 
Experience overseeing aseptic filling operations in a biologics manufacturing environment, including vial and prefilled syringe filling
 
 
Working knowledge of lyophilization, formulation, and aseptic technique, including barrier and isolator/RABS technologies
 
 
Working knowledge of contamination control, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulation requirements
 
 
**Experience With Multiproduct Biologics Facility Start-up Is Preferred**
Experience interacting with multiple health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA)
 
 
Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.
 
 
Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.
 
 
Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed onsite. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about onsite expectations for your role and location.
 
 
As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.
 
 
For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.
 
 
Salary Range (annually)
 
 
$175,700.00 - $292,700.00

source.title: Senior Manager Manufacturing  Night Shift Operations Performance & Integration
source.description:
Join Amgens Mission of Serving Patients
 
 
At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.
 
 
Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
 
 
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
 
 
Night Senior Manager Manufacturing Night Operations Performance & Integration (Continuous Improvement)
 
 
What you will do
 
 
Lets do this. Lets change the world. In this vital role the Night Shift Senior Manager of Manufacturing at Amgen is responsible for establishing and sustaining a strong night-shift operating system that provides off-shift operational direction for Commercial Operations and for Project based Commissioning and Qualification (C&Q) coverage, ensuring the right cross-functional resources are engaged, issues are escalated and resolved with urgency, and manufacturing performance is actively managed across the shift.
 
 
Partners with Engineering, Automation, QA, Technology, Maintenance, Supply Chain/Warehouse, Capital Projects.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
Serve as the senior Manufacturing integration point across night-shift operations during significant operational events.
 
 
Establish and sustain the night-shift Tier structure, operating cadence, escalation model, and performance-management routines.
 
 
Coordinate Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Engineering, Automation, Maintenance, Supply Chain/Warehouse, and other site resources required to maintain safe, compliant, and reliable operations.
 
 
Drive escalation of significant resource constraints, technical barriers, competing priorities, or unresolved operational issues to appropriate site or functional leadership.
 
 
Monitor overall night-shift Manufacturing performance across production lines, including downtime, OEE, schedule attainment, recurring interruptions, escalation effectiveness, and chronic losses.
 
 
Partner with the daytime Manufacturing Senior Manager, Continuous Improvement Senior Manager and MFG process Support Senior Manager to identify, prioritize, and execute improvement opportunities across off-shift, including 5S, visual management, standard work, workplace organization, waste reduction, flow improvement, and training operating discipline.
 
 
Provide coaching and situational leadership to Front Line Managers during complex operational events
 
 
What we expect of you
 
 
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek will possess these qualifications.
 
 
**Basic Qualifications**
Doctorate degree and 2 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
Masters degree and 6 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
Bachelors degree and 8 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
Associates degree and 10 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
High school diploma / GED and 12 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have a minimum of 2 years experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above
 
 
What you can expect of us
 
 
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, well support your journey every step of the way.
 
 
In Addition To The Base Salary, Amgen Offers a Total Rewards Plan, Based On Eligibility, Comprising Of Health And Welfare Plans For Staff And Eligible Dependents, Financial Plans With Opportunities To Save Towards Retirement Or Other Goals, Work/life Balance, And Career Development Opportunities That May Include
 
 
A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental & vision coverage, and life & disability insurance
 
 
A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
 
 
Stock-based long-term incentives
 
 
Award-winning time-off plans
 
 
Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.
 
 
Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.
 
 
careers.amgen.com
 
 
In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
 
 
Sponsorship
 
 
Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.
 
 
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.
 
 
Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 
 
We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities, consistent with legal requirements. Please contact us to request accommodation.
