source.title: Manufacturing Quality Senior Manager
source.description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality builds and leads the quality system supporting Harris' manufacturing network. This role owns quality and certifications across multiple facilities, including the ISO 9001 and ASME (non-nuclear) certification programs, inspection and hold/release, and independent verification of VDC deliverables, so products leave Harris' shops conforming to customer, code, and specification requirements.
 
 
This role builds and leads the plant-level QA/QC team, who will report directly to it. It holds quality stop-work authority and provides independent verification across facilities. The Senior Manager partners with the Harris corporate QA/QC program, applying and extending it to manufacturing, and works with Manufacturing Operations, Engineering and VDC, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, and Safety. The role standardizes quality practices and supports certification of new facilities as the network scales.
 
 
**Core Responsibilities**
**Quality Management System & Certifications**

* Own the manufacturing certification programs, including ISO 9001 and ASME, with documentation, internal audits, and management review.
* Lead certification and recertification for new and existing facilities, including customer and third-party audits.
* Align manufacturing procedures with the Harris corporate QMS manual and manage manufacturing-specific procedures and records.
* Drive consistent quality system implementation across the network.
* Represent Harris in professional and industry organizations.

**Plant QA/QC Leadership & Inspection**

* Build, staff, and lead the plant-level QA/QC team, including roles, hiring, training, and standards.
* Establish and own inspection, verification, and hold/release processes, from receiving through final inspection.
* Define inspection plans and travelers by product and customer requirement.
* Ensure welding procedures and welder qualifications meet code, and manage calibration of inspection equipment.
* Manage third-party inspection firms and their scope, schedule, and results

**VDC Deliverable QA/QC Review**

* Spot-check VDC deliverables, including drawings, models, and BOMs, before they reach the shop, as an independent check on VDC's own QA/QC.
* Audit VDC's QA/QC process and record results, and raise gaps with VDC leadership.
* Track shop-found drawing, model, and BOM issues, and feed trends back to VDC and Engineering.
* Hold deliverables that fail verification until corrected.

**Nonconformance, Corrective Action & Quality Performance**

* Own the nonconformance (NCR) process, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive actions, including supplier issues.
* Track and report quality metrics, including rework, weld repair, NCR trends, and customer complaints.
* Work with Industrial Engineering and plant leadership to turn quality data into improvements.

**Quality Stop-Work Authority**

* Exercise stop-work authority when product, process, or documentation does not meet requirements, escalating to the SVP as needed.
* Define clear criteria for stop, hold, and release.

**Production Readiness & Supplier Quality**

* Set quality requirements, inspection and test plans, and documentation for new products and projects at the production readiness gate and manage 3rd party inspection companies.
* Partner with Supply Chain on supplier quality, receiving inspection, and material certifications.
* Support customer quality requirements and audits for external customers.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
**This Role Works Closely With**

* Harris corporate QA/QC program leadership
* Manufacturing Operations, Industrial Engineering, Safety
* Engineering, VDC, and Product Engineering
* Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Fulfillment & Logistics
* Manufacturing Business Development and Estimating
* Customers, auditors, and certification bodies

The Senior Manager owns the manufacturing quality system and independent verification. Plant leadership owns producing quality product in the shop.
 
 
**Required Qualifications**

* Experience building and leading quality assurance or quality control across multiple manufacturing, fabrication, or prefabrication facilities, including hiring and developing quality staff.
* Experience leading ISO 9001 and ASME or other code-based certification and recertification, including internal audits and corrective action.
* Experience with inspection, nonconformance management, and root cause analysis.
* Ability to read engineering drawings, specifications, and codes.
* Ability to hold plant leaders accountable while keeping production moving.
* Strong communication skills with customers, auditors, and cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with nuclear quality assurance, ASME boiler and pressure vessel code, or other code-based quality programs.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* Experience with welding, piping, structural, or modular MEP fabrication.
* Certifications such as CWI, ASQ CQE/CQA/CMQ, or Lead Auditor.
* Experience with quality and production tracking systems such as STRATUS.

**This Role Is**
**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**

* The enterprise owner of the manufacturing quality system and certifications.
* The builder and leader of plant-level QA/QC across facilities.
* The authority for inspection, hold/release, and quality stop-work.
* An independent check that protects customers and Harris' reputation as the network scales.

**This Role Is NOT**

* The owner of plant production or shop-floor output (Manufacturing Operations).
* The owner of the Harris corporate QA/QC program.
* The owner of VDC's internal QA/QC (VDC).
* Responsible for safety programs or safety stop-work (Safety).
* The owner of product design or productization (Product Engineering).

**Your life at Harris**
As one of the country's leading mechanical contractors, Harris offers you the best of both worlds: the stability, resources and opportunities of a national company, and the team culture, creative spirit and customer loyalty of a local business. If you thrive on variety and new challenges, we want to meet you!
 
 
From stadiums to manufacturing facilities, power plants to hospitals, concert halls to classrooms, we handle projects of all sizes and complexity from multiple regional locations across the country.
 
 
**Harris Benefits + Compensation**

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 401K with company match
* Vacation time, sick time, and paid holidays
* Paid Parental leave
* Short-Term Incentive Plan

Visit our Careers Page for additional benefit details: https://www.harriscompany.com/careers/employee-benefits-at-a-glance
 
 
**Pay Range**
$111,060.64 - $166,590.97
 
 
The actual salary offer will vary by candidate based on a wide range of factors such as specific skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities
 
 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

source.title: Director, Operational Excellence
source.description:
**Job Title**
Director, Operational Excellence
 
 
**Agency**
Texas A&M University
 
 
**Department**
Strategy and Business Services
 
 
**Proposed Minimum Salary**
Commensurate
 
 
**Job Location**
College Station, Texas
 
 
**Job Type**
Staff
 
 
**Job Description**
**A Glimpse of the Job**
The Director, Operational Excellence provides strategic leadership and oversight for the Operational Excellence program. Directs the development and implementation of division-wide process improvement strategies, methodologies, governance frameworks, and performance measures that enhance operational effectiveness and service delivery. Leads a centralized Operational Excellence function while providing strategic guidance and oversight to embedded Operational Excellence resources across multiple divisions. Partners with senior leaders to identify opportunities for process optimization, organizational effectiveness, service improvements, and change initiatives that advance the university's mission and strategic priorities.
 
 
**Essential Duties**
**Operational Excellence Strategy, Governance & Leadership**

* Develops and executes the strategic vision, goals, and operating model for the Operational Excellence function
* Establishes governance structures, methodologies, standards, tools, and performance metrics for operational excellence initiatives
* Provides leadership and direction for division-wide continuous improvement efforts and organizational effectiveness programs
* Ensures alignment of priorities with institutional strategic objectives and administrative service goals
* Evaluates organizational performance and identifies opportunities to improve effectiveness, efficiency, service quality, and resource utilization

**Leadership of Operational Excellence Workforce**

* Provides oversight, coaching, and professional development for Operational Excellence staff, including analysts and embedded resources
* Establishes workforce strategies, competency models, career pathways, and development programs for staff
* Promotes consistent application of process improvement methodologies, analytical approaches, and change management practices across all teams
* Fosters collaboration and knowledge sharing among central and embedded Operational Excellence resources
* Monitors workload distribution, resource allocation, and organizational capacity to support strategic initiatives

**Consulting & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Serves as a trusted advisor to executive and administrative leadership on process improvement, organizational effectiveness, change management, and service enhancement strategies
* Leads the assessment of complex operational challenges and facilitates the development of sustainable solutions
* Oversees high-impact improvement initiatives across administrative and operational functions
* Facilitates executive-level discussions and cross-functional collaboration to remove barriers and improve organizational performance
* Recommends strategic operational changes supported by data, analysis, and stakeholder engagement

**Project Intake, Prioritization & Portfolio Management**

* Establishes and manages project intake and prioritization processes for Operational Excellence initiatives
* Evaluates requests for support and aligns resources based on organizational priorities, risks, and anticipated impact
* Monitors the progress, outcomes, and performance of projects and initiatives
* Provides executive reporting regarding project portfolios, organizational improvements, and return-on-investment measures
* Ensures appropriate coordination among stakeholders, project teams, and embedded Operational Excellence resources

**Stakeholder Engagement, Change Leadership & Communication**

* Builds collaborative relationships with campus leadership, functional experts, and administrative partners
* Promotes a culture of continuous improvement and service excellence throughout the organization
* Leads communication strategies that support organizational change and operational transformation initiatives
* Represents Operational Excellence initiatives to university leadership and governance groups
* Shares best practices, successes, and lessons learned to expand adoption of improvement principles and tools

**What You Need Know**
**Salary**
: Commensurate based on expereince
 
 
**Cover Letter/Resume:**
A cover letter and resume will assist us in our review of your application materials. These can be uploaded on the application under CV/Resume.
 
 
**Required Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Ten years of experience in relevant fields

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading an operational excellence, continuous improvement, organizational effectiveness, or business transformation function
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide process improvement and organizational change initiatives
* Experience building and developing high-performing professional teams
* Experience managing a portfolio of strategic projects and initiatives
* Experience utilizing data, metrics, and performance measures to drive organizational decision-making
* Lean Six Sigma, Project Management Professional (PMP), or similar professional certifications preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Knowledge of continuous improvement, organizational effectiveness, and change management principles and methodologies
* Skill in strategic planning, analysis, and problem-solving, including the ability to evaluate complex organizational issues, identify improvement opportunities, and develop data-informed solutions aligned with institutional priorities
* Ability to lead and develop high-performing teams, including coaching, mentoring, workforce planning, performance management, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability
* Skill in building collaborative relationships and influencing stakeholders, including the ability to effectively communicate with executive leadership, facilitate cross-functional initiatives, and achieve consensus among diverse constituent groups
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and resources in a complex organization, including the use of metrics, performance measures, and project portfolio management practices to achieve desired outcomes

**Other Requirements And Factors**

* This position is security sensitive
* This position requires compliance with state and federal laws/codes and Texas A&M University System/TAMU policies, regulations, rules and procedures
* All tasks and job responsibilities must be performed safely without injury to self or others in compliance with System and University safety requirements

**Instructions to Applicants:**
Applications received by Texas A&M University must either have all job application data entered or a resume attached. Failure to provide all job application data or a complete resume could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. We encourage all applicants to upload a resume’ or use a LinkedIn profile to pre-populate the online application.
 
 
All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.
 
 
Equal Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer.

source.title: Director, Central Quality Audit, Pharmacovigilance
source.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Managing, ensuring and improving capabilities to comply with external standards and regulations. Interprets internal and external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services. Stays informed of industry trends that may influence work. 
 
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Own the Pharmacovigilance (PV) Audit Program: Develop, implement, and maintain the global PV audit strategy, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations (e.g., EMA, FDA, MHRA, PMDA) and industry best practices.
* Manage Audit Operations: Oversee scheduling, planning, execution, reporting, and follow-up for PV audits, including internal audits and audits of service providers and affiliates. Fully participate in the audit program; actively owning and executing PV audits.
* Risk Identification and Communication: Identify high-risk compliance issues, escalate findings, and provide actionable recommendations to senior leadership.
* Regulatory Inspection Support: Prepare for and support PV-related health authority inspections, including back-room management and post-inspection follow-up.
* Metrics and Reporting: Define and track PV audit KPIs, ensuring visibility of compliance risks and trends to leadership.
* System Ownership: Manage audit-related modules within the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS), including support of configuration, UAT, and documentation.
* Team Leadership: Lead and develop a team of 3–5 auditors, providing coaching, mentorship, and performance management.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with PV Operations, Quality, and Regulatory teams to ensure audit outcomes drive continuous improvement.
* Strategic Influence: Contribute to policy development and influence PV compliance strategy across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience, including team development and performance management.
* Qualified Lead Auditor with active certification.
* Master’s degree and 5+ years in pharmacovigilance or pharmaceutical industry; or Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years relevant experience.
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience driving Global programs to resolve quality compliance issues (directly).
* Experience with Pharmaceutical QMS requirements and regulatory requirements including but not limited to cGMP, GDP, GPvP, GCP and GLP.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Experience with Medical Device QMS requirements and regulatory requirements including but not limited to FDA CFR 21 820 and ISO 13485.
* Prior Veeva and TrackWise Digital experience a plus.
* Prior health authority experience a plus.
* IRCA, ASQ (CQE, CQA, etc.) and/or Lean Certification a plus (green belt, black belt).
* Extensive experience in the Medica Device and Pharmaceutical industry.
* Understanding of product quality improvement using tools such as Six Sigma, DFR.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
* Exceptional conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to interface with top organizational leadership and internal and external customers, responding in a professional manner.
* Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to prioritize and drive multiple programs.
* Ability to energize others by building a connection with the team through personal involvement and trust, providing feedback and coaching to develop others, and accountability of actions.
* Strong oral and written communication skills in English.
* Integrity: Accepting and adhering to high ethical, moral, and personal values in decisions, communications, actions, and when dealing with others.
* Ability to travel globally up to 15%.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $142,400.00-$213,600.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

**Additional Information**
==========================

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

Application Deadline: December 21, 2026

source.description:
Overview:

**Hospital Name: Ohiohealth Rehabilitation Hospital** 
**Joint venture/Partnership/Affiliation with Select Medical** 
**Position:** **Director of Quality Management** 
**Location: Dublin, OH**

* Bonus incentives
* Extensive onboarding and training program
* Customizable health insurance packages

**Who We Are**

Our inpatient rehabilitation hospital is committed to providing exceptional and compassionate care to best address the medical, physical, emotional, and vocational challenges for individuals with brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, neurological disorders, orthopedic issues, amputation, and multiple traumas

Responsibilities:

Coordinates the Medical Quality Management and Performance Improvement activities to measurably enhance the quality, process and cost effectiveness of patient and customer services rendered. Coordinates the Performance Improvement and Patient Safety programs in accordance with the guidelines and regulatory requirements of Federal and State regulations on a hospital-wide basis. Oversees operations of the Infection Control and Employee Health Programs. Develops and Reviews policies and procedures to ensure compliance with all regulatory and accrediting standards. Collects data to monitor compliance and/or trends.

 

* Institutes and monitors the Hospital’s CQI Processes, utilizing data analysis measuring tools. Oversight/coordination of operations of the Infection Control & Employee Health Program based upon hospital size and configuration.
* Assists with the design and compliance of quality processes/activities in the areas of clinical/medical staff PI for all applicable clinical/medical TJC /CARF/DOH standards. Assists with all assigned activities to assure that the hospital maintains accreditation, certification and licensure. Assumes leadership with the Joint Commission and DOH as well as other regulatory agencies with regard to CQI activities.
* Serves as a resource for all departments within the facility to provide guidance on designing, implementing, analyzing and reporting on Quality Improvement.
* Assists clinical areas in developing criteria, monitoring and reporting mechanisms and action documentation related to the hospital’s CQI program.
* Performs basic chart review activities with appropriate staff for outcome utilization, infection control and medical CQI indicators. Analyzes results of chart review activities with appropriate staff and confers with department staff on any case requiring special attention.
* Prepares analysis of significant PI findings pertaining to adverse drug reactions, drug usage evaluation, medical management of acute transfers and other CQI indicators.

Qualifications:

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Registered Nurse with valid state license. Legacy employees may exist with other clinical licensure.
* Requires experience in at least one of the core areas of responsibility: Quality, Survey Readiness, Risk Management, Infection Control, Employee Health and Education
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including TJC and CARF preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Previous experience in Quality Improvement, with Statistical Process Control experience and computer skills preferred.
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including JCAHO and CARF preferred.
* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) preferred

Additional Data:

source.title: Director of Quality
source.description:
**About the Role:**

As Director of Quality, you’ll lead Helix’s quality department and drive the development of systems, practices, and people to ensure product excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction. You’ll hire, train, and manage the team, own the quality system, and make it clear who is responsible for quality at every step.

You’ll report directly to the Chief Executive Officer, partner closely with Engineering, Operations, and our customers to build a proactive, scalable, and right-sized quality system that enables growth.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership & Systems Development**

* Develop and continuously improve a scalable Quality Management System aligned with AS9100 and customer requirements
* Lead departmental strategy, structure, and capital planning to support business growth
* Serve as ISO/AS Management Representative

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and mentor a team of 5+ quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians
* Develop people and build team capabilities in metrology, inspection, and quality engineering
* Foster a culture of collaboration and real-time problem-solving on the shop floor

**Customer & Compliance Management**

* Lead customer and supplier audits; own response and resolution of corrective actions
* Ensure documentation, compliance, and audit readiness
* Build trusted relationships with key customers and act as the face of Quality

**Quality Engineering & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with operators to implement in-process quality at the machine (not just post-process inspection)
* Drive root cause analysis, SPC implementation, and corrective actions to reduce scrap and improve first-pass yield
* Support new product introductions and ensure proper gauges, fixtures, and inspection plans are in place

**Internal Inspection & Production Support**

* Oversee first-piece, in-process, and final inspection plans
* Continuously simplify and optimize inspection methods to reduce bottlenecks without sacrificing quality

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Promoting Operational Excellence by initiating and helping implement continuous improvement objectives.
* Maintaining a robust QMS system and compliance to AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards.
* Leading the company during customer audits and independent audits towards successful (re)certification.
* Lowering scrap and increasing first pass yield.
* Cross functional collaboration with Production and Engineering to help build quality into the process.
* Implementing solid Corrective Actions to reduce RMAs and DMRs.
* Establishing best practices for the Quality department and the organization as a whole

### **Who You Are**

* A pragmatic quality leader who blends systems thinking with real-world shop floor experience
* Confident navigating between big-picture strategy and hands-on process improvement
* A builder of systems and people, able to lead a team and train on complex equipment
* Comfortable in a customer-facing role and able to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Committed to continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivering value across departments

### **Qualifications:**

**Must-Haves**

* 10+ years in manufacturing quality, preferably in machining-based environments
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards
* Experience leading customer and regulatory audits
* Proven people management skills
* Working knowledge of metrology, CMM, GD&T, and SPC tools
* Experience balancing compliance with operational efficiency

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Mechanical or technical degree
* Experience supporting New Product Development (NPD)
* Six Sigma, Lean, or ASQ certifications (CQE, CQA, CQM)
* Familiarity with vision systems, statistical software (e.g., Minitab), and automation of inspection processes

**About the Company:**

Helix Linear Technologies designs and manufactures high-precision motion control systems for industries where performance matters most, like aerospace, medical devices, and industrial automation. We’re in a phase of strategic growth, investing in R&D, advanced equipment, and new product lines, including aerospace-grade ball screws.

Our clean, climate-controlled facility is built for precision, focus, and continuous improvement. At Helix, you’ll join a team that values ownership, technical excellence, and curiosity.

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits, a retirement savings plan with company match, and paid time off and company holidays.

Helix Linear Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Due to U.S. export control laws, applicants must be U.S. persons (U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident).

source.description:
**Job Description:**
Saab's Aeronautics Business is seeking a highly engaged, motivated and experienced
**Director of Quality**
to develop and lead a world-class aerospace quality organization.
 
 
The ideal candidate possesses strong leadership skills, the ability to identify process improvement opportunities and significant experience in developing and executing integrated strategies in manufacturing operations. They bring strong analytical, strategic, and relationship-building capabilities, along with a proven track record of developing next-level quality leaders. This position will be based in West Lafayette, IN.
 
 
**Responsibilities will include:**

* Employee management and engagement and compliance to relevant standards/requirements.
* Work collaboratively with Program Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production to maximize efficiencies, achieve objectives, and improve overall safety and product quality in the business.
* Develop a strong relationship with Saab’s Global Aeronautics Business Area team and continually develop and improve global and local processes.
* Manage transfer of technology programs for products moving from Sweden to the US.
* Ensure proper staffing to effectively perform all responsibilities. This includes having the right skill mix to cover all areas of responsibility in global operations.
* Keep management and others informed of significant issues or developments.
* Support other departments/functions as needed to ensure operational efficiencies.
* Develop quality team via internal and external educational and experiential opportunities.
* Provide costing data to support proposal efforts.
* Resolve external quality issues. This may include direct government and/or customer contact, interaction with the program management team, or others close to the issue to resolve and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Work with peers in the management team to establish quality improvement strategies and plans.
* Ensure internal audits of existing processes are being performed and changing/evaluating as necessary to continually meet/exceed customer expectations.
* Perform formal root cause analysis on product/process related issues.
* Utilize risk assessment tools (e.g., PFMEAs) to identify actions to reduce risks.
* Lead key improvement projects, providing leadership in developing practical solutions to complex problems.
* Improve processes using Kaizen, process mapping, 6s, or other lean tools.
* Identify trends and process variations for future improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance across all areas of responsibility.

**Compensation Range:**
$165,700 - $223,800
 
 
The compensation range provided is a general guideline. When extending an offer, Saab, Inc. considers factors including (but not limited to) the role and associated responsibilities, location, and market and business considerations, as well as the candidate's work experience, key skills, and education/training.
 
 
**Skills and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Quality or related discipline is required. Master’s degree is a plus.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Aerospace or Defense.
* 5+ years in a Quality management role in Aerospace or Defense.
* Lean training and experience / certification a plus.
* A proven track record of implementing improvements.
* Experience with customer (USG) interaction and problem resolution.
* Strong analytical, prioritizing, interpersonal, problem-solving, presentation, budgeting, project management skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience in AS9100 Quality Systems in an Aerospace or Defense company.
* Ability to develop and maintain collaborative relationships with peers and colleagues across the organization, as well as internal and external clients.
* Ability to form partnerships with foreign national partners in order to maximize results.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team to achieve strategic goals.
* Experience with the development and production of aerospace systems required.

**Citizenship Requirements:**
Must be a U.S. citizen. Applicants selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
 
 
**Drug-Free Workplaces:**
Saab is a federal government contractor and adheres to policies and programs necessary for sustaining drug-free workplaces. As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to pass a pre-employment drug screen.
 
 
**Benefits:**
Saab provides an excellent working environment offering professional growth opportunities, competitive wages, work-life balance, a business casual atmosphere and comprehensive benefits.
 
 
Highlights include:
 
 

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance for employees and dependents
* Generous paid time off, including 8 designated holidays
* 401(k) with employer contributions
* Tuition assistance and student loan assistance
* Wellness and employee assistance resources
* Employee stock purchase opportunities
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage

**About Us:**
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. In the U.S., Saab delivers advanced technology and systems, supporting the U.S. Armed Forces and the Federal Aviation Administration, as well as international and commercial partners. Headquartered in Syracuse, New York, the company has business units and local employees in ten U.S. locations.
 
 
Saab is a company where we see diversity as an asset and offer unlimited opportunities for advancing in your career. We are also a company that respects each person’s needs and encourage employees to lead a balanced, rewarding life beyond work. Saab values diversity and is an Affirmative Action employer for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Saab is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, all qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran, disability status, or any other federal, state, or locally protected category.

**for You.**
Keel was formed by bringing together three industry leaders combining generations of hands-on expertise in steel fabrication, shipbuilding, aerospace, and defense manufacturing.
 
 
That means when you join Keel, you’re joining a team backed by decades of proven craftsmanship and real-world results.
 
 
We build ships, defense systems, aerospace components, and heavy steel structures that serve critical missions — and we do it with pride.
 
 
**Your Mission**
The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership, technical oversight, and compliance governance for multiple heavy fabrication plants producing structural weldments, assemblies, and machined components for the Nuclear Navy. This role ensures full alignment with ISO 9001, NAVSEA, and customer specific requirements.
 
 
**Explore The Depth Of The Role**

* Provide strategic leadership for quality operations across three South Carolina fabrication facilities supporting U.S. Navy shipbuilding and defense manufacturing programs.
* Ensure all products meet contractual, technical, regulatory, NAVSEA, and quality requirements while driving continuous improvement in customer satisfaction and product performance.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with customer, industry, and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the primary quality interface for customers, government representatives, auditors, and regulatory agencies, leading quality reviews, audits, corrective actions, and performance discussions.
* Direct all quality assurance, quality control, inspection, test, dimensional verification, NDT, welding quality, and supplier quality activities across the region.
* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics including First-Time Quality (FTQ), Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), defect escapes, rework, audit findings, and inspection cycle time.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives to eliminate recurring nonconformances and improve manufacturing performance.
* Drive operational excellence through improved inspection efficiency, resource utilization, process standardization, and deployment of risk-based quality methodologies.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to proactively prevent defects and improve overall manufacturing effectiveness.
* Build and sustain a culture where quality, compliance, workmanship excellence, and customer focus are integrated into daily operations at all levels of the organization.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and lead Quality Managers, Engineers, Supervisors, Auditors, and Inspectors while building organizational capability and succession plans.
* Other related duties as assigned.

**Requirements**
**Mission Readiness:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or related technical discipline; Master's Degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive quality leadership experience in shipbuilding, defense, defense manufacturing, heavy fabrication, aerospace, or similar industries.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-site quality organizations.
* Root cause analysis and corrective action applied to nonconformances and recurring defects
* Quality auditing, including internal, supplier, and customer audit planning, execution, and follow-up
* Data analysis and reporting using quality metrics, dashboards, and tools such as Excel, Power BI, and ERP/QMS software
* Contract and technical document review, including drawings, specifications, work instructions, and inspection plans
* Executive-level presentation and negotiation skills for customer meetings, corrective action reviews, and dispute resolution
* Quality Management Systems: AS9100, ISO 9001, Navy QA requirements, nonconformance management, and CAPA
* Welding and NDT Oversight: Weld procedures, inspection methods, and material traceability in accordance with NAVSEA requirements
* Supplier Quality: Qualifying, auditing, and developing suppliers; preventing counterfeit or nonconforming material
* Regulatory and Contract Compliance: Government source inspection, DCMA surveillance, and audit readiness
* Continuous Improvement and Leadership: Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and developing quality talent
* Track and report cost of quality (prevention, appraisal, internal and external failure) and drive reductions in rework and scrap
* Support program pricing, proposals, and forecasts with accurate quality labor and resource estimates
* Evaluate the cost, schedule, and risk impact of quality decisions, such as rework, repair, and corrective action investments

**Travel Requirements**
Between facilities as needed
 
 
**Physical Requirements**

* May be required to stand, walk, sit, reach/pull/push with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel regularly.
* May lift or carry 50lbs. Weights exceeding 50lbs will require mechanical means to maneuver.

* Competitive Pay

source.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance
source.description:
Denali Therapeutics Inc. is a biotechnology company pioneering a new class of biotherapeutics designed to cross the blood-brain barrier (BBB) using its proprietary TransportVehicle™ platform. With the first FDA-approved biologic specifically designed to cross the BBB, a clinically validated delivery platform and a growing portfolio of therapeutic candidates across all stages of development, we are advancing toward our goal of delivering effective medicines to transform the lives of people living with neurodegenerative diseases, lysosomal storage disorders and other serious diseases.
 
 
We invite you to consider an opportunity with Denali to help achieve our goal of delivering meaningful therapeutics to patients.
 
 
Based in Salt Lake City (SLC), the Senior Manager, Quality Assurance (QA) will drive quality assurance defined strategies and objectives for a new large molecule drug substance clinical and commercial manufacturing facility. This includes manufacturing and analytical testing operations, ensuring compliance with FDA, EMA, and global regulatory requirements. This role manages a team responsible for key quality systems including quality on the floor, batch disposition, quality events, GMP documentation and validation.. The position also partners with Manufacturing, QC, and CMC teams to maintain product quality, data integrity, and inspection readiness. The Senior Manager, QA also drives continuous improvement and fosters a strong culture of GMP compliance and operational excellence.
 
 
**Key Accountabilities / Core Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership to strengthen site quality systems and elevate overall regulatory compliance across manufacturing and testing operations.
* Provide quality oversight for GMP manufacturing and QC laboratory operations to ensure adherence to FDA, EMA, and global regulatory standards. Includes ~ 15%+ spent “on the floor” providing guidance and oversight.
* Review and approve batch records and supporting documentation to support timely and compliant batch disposition and product release.
* Lead and oversee the management of quality events, including deviations, investigations, CAPA, and change controls to ensure effective root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Maintain hands-on leadership and subject matter expertise in GMP quality operations, ensuring effective implementation and continuous improvement of the QMS.
* Provide quality oversight for qualification and validation activities, including process validation, equipment qualification, and validation lifecycle management.
* Oversee site GMP documentation review and approval.
* Partner cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality Control, Validation, and Regulatory teams to drive quality operations, inspection readiness, and continuous process improvement.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of quality professionals, fostering a strong culture of GMP compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement. Lead direct reports through annual goal setting, growth planning, adherence to company policies, maintain training compliance and provide ongoing feedback on growth, development and areas of improvement.

**Qualifications/Skills**

* Typically requires Bachelor’s degree in a core scientific discipline with 8+ years of overall work experience, including 3+ years in Biotech Manufacturing / Quality and 3+ years people management experience
* Familiarity with large molecule drug substance GMP manufacturing and testing
* Knowledge of current USP/Ph. Eur./FDA/ISO/GMP standards and guidance
* Ability to work independently or in team environments under deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to closely follow quality standards and company quality expectations
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills
* Strategic thinking combined with excellence in execution
* Ability to learn quickly, driven by high curiosity

Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. Denali offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k, healthcare coverage, ESPP and a broad range of other benefits. Learn more at https://www.denalitherapeutics.com/careers
 
 
This compensation and benefits information is based on Denali’s good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.
 
 
Denali is committed to its core company value of unity by creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, basis of disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

source.title: Director, Risk Management and Quality
source.description:
**Director of Risk Management and Quality**

**Who We Are:**

At Triangle Springs, we are committed to empowering and supporting a diverse and determined workforce who can drive quality, scalability, and significant impact across our hospitals and communities. In your role, you’ll support those that are in our facilities who are interfacing and providing care to our patients and community members. We believe that our collective efforts will shape a healthier future for the communities we serve. Our programs offer customized rehabilitation tailored to the specific needs of those recovering from a stroke, brain injury, neurological conditions, trauma, spinal cord injury, amputation or orthopedic injury.

**Why Choose Us:**

* Affordable medical, dental and vision plans provided to meet the needs of full-time employees and their families
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Tuition reimbursement, continuing education opportunities and apprenticeship programs for eligible employees
* 401(K) retirement plans
* Flexible spending and health savings accounts

**How you’ll contribute:**

The Director of Risk Management and Quality is responsible for the development and administration of Performance Improvement, Risk Management, and Staff Development activities throughout the hospital to ensure that all state, federal, and Joint Commission standards for care are consistently met. The Director collects and analyzes data on hospital performance, incidents, and documentation to improve hospital performance and ensure provision of quality care. The Director works closely with all department leaders to recommend and provide required staff development and tailored programs based upon data analysis. The Director monitors, investigates, and as required, reports all hospital incidents. 
 
**Essential Functions:**

To perform this job, an individual must perform each essential function satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Provides oversight and continuous monitoring of the hospital’s quality program, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and best‑practice standards.
* Demonstrates comprehensive expertise in all applicable regulatory requirements, including The Joint Commission (TJC), Medicaid, and state and federal healthcare laws.
* Serves as a key advisor to department leaders by interpreting regulatory standards, offering guidance, and supporting compliance readiness.
* Partners with hospital staff to proactively identify risk and safety concerns, leading the development and execution of corrective action plans.
* Collects, analyzes, and interprets performance data to evaluate hospital outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Oversees the incident reporting process, ensuring timely documentation, investigation, data analysis, and reporting to the Quality Council and the Chief Executive Officer.
* Utilizes the Plan‑Do‑Check‑Act (PDCA) methodology to design, implement, and measure improvement initiatives that enhance quality and patient safety.
* Ensures ongoing organizational compliance with all regulatory standards and applicable laws, maintaining survey readiness at all times.
* Always exhibit the company’s core values of champion patient care, do the right thing, embrace individuality, act with kindness, and making a difference together.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in counseling, Social Work, Nursing, or related clinical field from an accredited school required. Master’s degree in clinical field from an accredited school preferred.
* Counseling, Social Work, or Registered Nurse license preferred.
* Three years of risk management and regulatory compliance in a healthcare setting are required.
* CPR certification is required within 30 days of employment and prior to any patient contact.
* De-escalation certification is required within 30 days of employment and prior to any patient contact.

**EEOC Statement:**

Triangle Springs is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunities for all applicants and employees and complies with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of color, race, sex, age, religion, national origin, disability, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, veterans' status or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

We employ and provide care to people from all walks of life. We are committed to promoting healing, providing hope, preserving dignity and producing value with an inclusive workforce in which diversity is leveraged, respected, and reflective of the patients, family members, customers and team members we serve.Lifepoint Health is a leader in community-based care and driven by a mission of Making Communities Healthier. Our diversified healthcare delivery network spans 29 states and includes 63 community hospital campuses, 32 rehabilitation and behavioral health hospitals, and more than 170 additional sites of care across the healthcare continuum, such as acute rehabilitation units, outpatient centers and post-acute care facilities. We believe that success is achieved through talented people. We want to create places where employees want to work, with opportunities to pursue meaningful and satisfying careers that truly make a difference in communities across the country.

source.title: Administrative Director of Inpatient Quality and Operations, Department of Medicine
source.description:
Department Overview:

The Department of Medicine (DoM) at OHSU is comprised of a diverse community of faculty, staff, clinicians, researchers, educators, and learners dedicated to advancing patient care, education, and research across ten divisions.

The Director of Inpatient Quality and Operations provides strategic leadership, operational oversight, quality management, and performance improvement support for inpatient clinical services across the Department of Medicine's ten specialty divisions and care sites. Reporting to the Vice Chair of Clinical Practice and partnering closely with the Vice Chair for Administration, this position serves as the Department's primary administrative leader for inpatient quality, patient safety, operational performance, and clinical effectiveness initiatives.

Function/Duties of Position:

Working collaboratively with DoM and OHSU Health quality leaders, division leadership, hospital operations, finance, revenue cycle, informatics, care management, nursing leadership, clinical documentation teams, and physician leaders, the Director advances the Department's inpatient quality, operational, clinical, and financial goals through the design, implementation, and oversight of standardized processes, performance improvement efforts, operational reporting, and strategic initiatives.

Emphasis is placed on quality programing and outcomes, patient safety, clinical documentation integrity, coding accuracy, revenue cycle performance, operational efficiency, provider productivity, inpatient capacity management, and growth planning across all Department of Medicine inpatient services. The Director supports a broad portfolio of inpatient programs spanning multiple clinical specialties and care settings.

This position functions within a highly matrixed environment and serves as a key liaison between departmental leadership and enterprise partners, ensuring alignment with OHSU Health strategic priorities, quality objectives, and high-reliability organizational principles.

**Inpatient Quality and Operations Leadership and Oversight**

* Work in direct partnership with the DoM Vice Chair of Clinical Practice, DoM Associate Vice Chair of Inpatient Services, Healthcare quality leaders, and other institutional leaders to oversee and coordinate quality-focused inpatient care across Department of Medicine divisions.
* Provide strategic administrative leadership and operational oversight for Department of Medicine inpatient programs and services.
* Serve as the Department's primary administrative leader for inpatient quality, patient safety, operational performance, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Partner with division heads, section heads, medical directors, healthcare administrators, quality leaders, and physician leaders to identify and address operational and quality barriers affecting patient safety, access, efficiency, provider experience, and clinical outcomes.
* Shape and implement standardized inpatient quality, safety, and operational best practices across medicine specialties.
* Coordinate departmental quality improvement initiatives focused on reducing medical errors, serious safety events, healthcare-associated infections, hospital-acquired conditions, avoidable readmissions, preventable complications, and patient harm.
* Lead administrative efforts related to inpatient quality programs, patient safety activities, inpatient capacity management, patient flow, consult services, discharge efficiency, care coordination, and service-line optimization.
* Support departmental participation in mortality reviews, safety event reviews, quality committees, accreditation activities, regulatory preparedness efforts, and institutional quality initiatives.
* Establish and maintain departmental quality and operational governance structures, including scorecards, dashboards, performance reviews, and accountability processes.
* Partner with healthcare quality teams to identify opportunities for improvement and coordinate development of corrective action plans.
* Serve as the primary administrative liaison between Department of Medicine leadership, inpatient programs, Healthcare quality teams, and hospital operations leadership.
* Monitor operational, quality, and patient safety performance measures and drive action planning to improve outcomes.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary teams and stakeholder groups responsible for advancing inpatient quality, safety, throughput, and operational effectiveness.

**Revenue Cycle, Billing, Coding, and Clinical Documentation Integrity**

* Serve as the Department's operational lead for inpatient professional revenue cycle performance.
* Partner with Revenue Cycle, Professional Coding, Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI), Finance, Compliance, and physician leaders to improve revenue capture, reimbursement, and operational performance.
* Evaluate and improve inpatient provider documentation practices, coding accuracy, charge capture processes, and billing workflows.
* Lead provider education efforts related to documentation requirements, coding regulations, payer expectations, reimbursement methodologies, and compliance standards.
* Monitor inpatient professional fee performance, wRVU generation, Case Mix Index (CMI), coding trends, denials, reimbursement outcomes, and documentation quality measures.

* Lead complex inpatient operational and quality improvement initiatives utilizing Lean, process improvement, project management, and change management methodologies.
* Design and implement department-wide initiatives focused on improving quality outcomes, patient safety, throughput, provider experience, financial performance, and operational consistency.
* Conduct workflow analyses and redesign efforts to eliminate inefficiencies, reduce variation in care delivery, and improve service performance.
* Collaborate with Quality, Analytics, Finance, Informatics, and Operations teams to establish measurable goals and monitor outcomes.
* Develop project charters, implementation plans, success metrics, and performance benchmarks for strategic initiatives.
* Support departmental strategic planning activities and implementation of enterprise priorities related to inpatient growth, quality, and operational excellence.
* Advance high-reliability organization principles and support compliance with accreditation and regulatory requirements.

**Data Analytics, Reporting, and Financial Performance**

* Develop and maintain operational, financial, quality, patient safety, and utilization reporting structures for departmental and divisional leadership.
* Establish and maintain comprehensive inpatient quality scorecards and dashboards.
* Monitor and analyze key performance indicators including:
 + Analyze trends in inpatient volumes, utilization, consult activity, throughput, revenue cycle performance, patient outcomes, and quality metrics.
 + Translate complex operational and quality data into actionable recommendations for leaders.
 + Benchmark Department performance against institutional, regional, and national metrics when available.
 + Support financial forecasting, business case development, and investment planning for inpatient growth initiatives.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Committee Leadership**

* Represent the Department of Medicine on institutional committees related to quality, patient safety, inpatient operations, revenue cycle, clinical documentation, care management, patient flow, and performance improvement.
* Build collaborative partnerships with hospital administrators, nursing leaders, physicians, quality teams, informatics, finance, and operational stakeholders.
* Provide subject matter expertise regarding inpatient quality, safety, operational performance, workflow redesign, and professional revenue optimization.
* Lead communication, stakeholder engagement, and change management activities for major inpatient initiatives.
* Support development of a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, patient safety, and operational excellence throughout Department of Medicine inpatient programs.

Required Qualifications:

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, finance, or a related field is required. Master’s degree may substitute for one (1) year of experience.

**Experience**

* Minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in clinical operations or healthcare administration, with at least two (2) years in a formal leadership role.
* Experience supporting inpatient hospital operations, quality improvement, patient safety, healthcare finance, revenue cycle, or operational excellence initiatives.
* Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives within healthcare organizations.
* Experience working collaboratively with physician leaders, nursing leadership, and hospital operational teams.
* Experience developing performance metrics, scorecards, dashboards, and operational improvement plans.

**Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of inpatient healthcare operations and physician practice management.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare quality improvement, patient safety, performance measurement, and high-reliability organizational principles.
* Knowledge of inpatient reimbursement methodologies, documentation requirements, clinical coding, and revenue cycle practices.
* Knowledge of regulatory, accreditation, and quality reporting requirements affecting inpatient healthcare delivery.
* Advanced analytical, reporting, and data interpretation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop quality scorecards, operational dashboards, and executive-level performance reporting.
* Ability to analyze complex clinical, operational, financial, and quality data and translate findings into actionable improvement strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale operational and performance improvement initiatives across multiple clinical specialties.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary efforts focused on reducing medical errors, improving patient outcomes, and advancing a culture of safety.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, Epic, reporting platforms, and healthcare analytics tools.
* Strong financial acumen, strategic planning, and business case development capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

**Education**

Master’s Degree in Health Care Administration, Business, Public Health or Nursing; or Bachelor’s degree with equivalent combination of education, experience and training.

**Experience**

* Eight or more years of progressively responsible healthcare operations, quality, or performance improvement experience.
* Academic medical center experience.
* Experience with inpatient physician billing and professional fee revenue cycle.
* Experience with quality reporting, patient safety programs, accreditation activities, and regulatory readiness.
* Experience with Epic reporting, provider productivity analysis, CDI initiatives, and coding optimization.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or process improvement certification or training.
* Matrix leadership experience.

**Competencies**

Demonstrated ability to leverage advanced analytics, financial modeling, forecasting tools, artificial intelligence-enabled technologies, and other data-driven methodologies to improve operational efficiency, inform strategic decision-making, optimize resource allocation, and support sustainable program growth.

Additional Details:

Professional office environment; may include occasional travel to affiliate and partner sites. In-person work schedule expected, with limited telework acceptable.

Operates in an environment with frequent interruptions, multiple competing priorities, and extensive interaction with faculty, staff, trainees, and institutional partners.

source.title: Vice President of Operations, Piston Interiors
source.description:
The Vice President of Operations at Piston Interiors is a key member of the executive leadership team, reporting directly to the President. This role provides enterprise-level leadership for Piston Interiors operations across the United States and Mexico and has direct responsibility for multi-plant manufacturing execution across five manufacturing facilities in northern Mexico and two distribution centers along the Texas border, supporting a workforce of more than 7,000 employees. The VP of Operations leads Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and launch execution; drives Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Productivity, Profitability, and Customer Performance; and builds a culture of disciplined continuous improvement, leadership accountability, and reliable execution. Candidate must be located in Acuna, Mexico or Metro-Detroit, United States to be considered for this position. Relocation will be considered.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Operations Leadership**

* Serve as the senior-most Operations executive for Piston Int eriors, setting enterprise direction across U.S. and Mexico

operations and maintaining direct accountability for manufacturing and distribution performance across all locations.
 
 

* Establish a clear manufacturing approach and translate business strategy into annual operating plans, budgets, capital

priorities, capacity decisions, and measurable operating objectives.
 
 

* Advise the President and executive leadership team on operating performance, customer commitments, risk, growth

readiness, resource requirements, and strategic opportunities.
 
 
**Multi-Site Operations & Performance Accountability**

* Lead plant and distribution-center execution across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, labor efficiency, schedule

attainment, scrap, premium freight, inventory, throughput, and profitability.
 
 

* Establish consistent daily, weekly, and monthly management cadence, visual controls, performance measures,

escalation routines, and corrective-action discipline across the operating network.
 
 

* Ensure safe working conditions, regulatory and legal compliance, ethical conduct, operational continuity, and reliable

delivery of customer commitments.
 
 
**Piston Production System (PPS), Lean & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the cultural and process transformation from maximizing production-minute utilization to a disciplined focus on

productivity, efficiency, quality, flow, profitability, and sustainable performance.
 
 

* Deploy and sustain the Piston Production System, including standard work, visual management, tiered accountability,

structured problem solving, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, and continuous improvement.
 
 

* Use operational data and technology to improve labor utilization, first-pass yield, scrap, downtime, throughput,

process capability, and decision quality.
 
 
**Financial Performance & Resource Optimization**

* Own operating performance against profit-and-loss, cash, working-capital, productivity, cost-reduction, and annual

operating-plan commitments.
 
 

* Plan and manage direct and indirect labor, operating budgets, capital, equipment, facilities, inventory, logistics, and

other resources in alignment with financial objectives.
 
 

* Partner with Finance to understand cost drivers, program and customer profitability, forecast accuracy, capital returns,

and the financial impact of operating decisions.
 
 
**Supply Chain, Capacity & Cross-Border Operations**

* Provide executive oversight for production planning, materials, purchasing, logistics, distribution, supplier

performance, capacity, inventory, and business continuity.
 
 

* Optimize manufacturing and distribution capacity across the United States and Mexico while ensuring compliance with

applicable IMMEX, customs, import/export, USMCA, labor, and regulatory requirements.
 
 
**Growth, Engineering & Launch Excellence**

* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Finance, and Supply Chain to secure and launch new

business with disciplined manufacturability, capacity, cost, capital, quality, and resource assumptions.
 
 

* Lead integrated launch readiness and execution, protecting existing operations while meeting customer timing,

delivery, quality, and profitability expectations.
 
 
**Organization & Talent Leadership**

* Review and optimize the operations organization structure, leadership capability, spans of control, role clarity, and

succession depth required to support current performance and future growth.
 
 

* Build, coach, and hold accountable a cohesive, high-performing multi-plant leadership team; align goal setting,

performance, development, and succession practices with the ONE PISTON Talent Cycle.
 
 
**Culture, Customer & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Inspire a culture of winning, disciplined execution, continuous improvement, trust, and collaboration while maintaining

an organizational climate that prioritizes safety, dignity, pride, satisfaction, and well-being at work.
 
 

* Build credibility with customers, employees, executive leaders, suppliers, and community stakeholders through

transparent communication, predictable results, ethical leadership, and decisive action.
 
 
**Qualifications**
**Education / Experience / Skills & Abilities**

* Bachelor’s degree required in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field;

Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
 
 

* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience within automotive manufacturing,

including significant multi-site responsibility and leadership through other leaders.
 
 

* Automotive Tier 1 supplier experience required, with direct accountability for manufacturing, quality, industrial

engineering, supply chain, program/launch execution, customer delivery, and plant financial performance.
 
 

* Demonstrated profit-and-loss leadership, including budgeting, forecasting, labor management, working capital, capital

planning, cost reduction, and profitability improvement.
 
 

* Proven success implementing lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, daily management systems, and plant or

network turnaround initiatives.
 
 

* Significant experience leading U.S.-Mexico cross-border manufacturing operations; experience within an IMMEX

maquiladora environment strongly preferred.
 
 

* Experience in automotive interiors, cut-and-sew, seat trim, visors, leather/vinyl processing, or other labor-intensive

manufacturing strongly preferred.
 
 

* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish required.
* Strong business acumen, analytical capability, technical manufacturing knowledge, and the ability to communicate,

influence, negotiate, and build trust across all organizational levels and stakeholders.

source.title: Director of Quality
source.description:
Signia Aerospace is a global, integrated provider of high-performance systems and specialized components for the aerospace industry. Signia designs, manufactures, and services a wide range of products, that include mission equipment, thermal management systems, engine technology, and propellers. The Signia brands are leaders in their respective markets and provide a compelling value proposition to both aerospace and defense OEMs and end-users.

**Position Overview**

Onboard Systems Hoist & Winch, located in Anaheim, CA is one of the world’s leading providers of Search & Rescue (SAR) and Human External Cargo (HEC) advanced mission equipment for civil, commercial, and military helicopters.

The Director of Quality is a key leadership position reporting directly to the General Manager (GM), responsible for establishing and executing the company's overall quality strategy. This role provides strategic direction and oversight of the Quality function, ensuring the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS), compliance with AS9100 and applicable regulatory and customer requirements, and continuous improvement across all business operations. As the designated FAA Part 145 Accountable Manager, the Director has authority over all Part 145 repair-station operations, ensures personnel follow applicable FAA regulations, and serves as the primary contact with the FAA. The Director also partners with executive and operational leadership to drive quality performance, manage organizational risk, and foster a company-wide culture of quality and accountability.

**Location:** Anaheim, CA (on-site)

**Schedule:** Monday - Friday

**Pay:** $180,000 - $225,000, plus bonus eligibility

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Quality Management System Leadership**

* Establish quality strategy, policies, and measurable objectives aligned with the company's business goals.
* Own and administer the company-wide Quality Management System in accordance with AS9100 (which incorporates ISO 9001) and applicable customer and regulatory requirements, including FAA and, where applicable, EASA requirements.
* Oversee the FAA Part 145 repair-station quality control system, including the Repair Station Manual, Quality Control Manual, Operations Specifications, and documented inspection and return-to-service controls.
* Ensure the QMS is effective, scalable, consistently deployed across the business, and aligned with the company's growth and product roadmap
* Lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives to optimize quality processes, procedures, documentation, and controls.
* Manage document control and maintain accurate, controlled quality procedures, process documentation, and compliance records.

**2. Compliance & Customer Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for external audits, including AS9100 certification audits, customer audits, and regulatory assessments.
* Prepare the organization for audits and lead audit responses, corrective actions, and follow-up activities to verify effective closure.
* Build and maintain credibility and trust with executive stakeholders, aerospace OEM customers, auditors, regulatory officials, and relevant industry partners.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable standards, customer requirements, and contractual quality clauses.
* Oversee incoming, in-process, and final manufacturing inspections, including first article inspection (FAI) activities to AS9102 when required by contract or approved procedures, while maintaining distinct FAA Part 145 maintenance-inspection and return-to-service controls.

**3. Quality Assurance**

* Ensure timely containment and investigation of quality issues using methods such as A3, 8D, and 5 Whys, with documented root cause and corrective action (RCCA).
* Support Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams with timely quality guidance and issue resolution.
* Establish quality KPIs and targets, monitor trends, and report performance and improvement plans to the GM and leadership team.
* Use data-driven insights to improve customer satisfaction, compliance, and product consistency; reduce defects and cost of poor quality (COPQ); and verify corrective-action effectiveness.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate product safety, airworthiness, quality, and compliance risks; escalate significant issues to leadership and track mitigation actions to closure.
* Establish clear escalation pathways for nonconforming product and airworthiness concerns; prevent unauthorized product release and ensure release decisions remain with appropriately authorized personnel.
* Lead internal audits and management reviews to ensure ongoing system effectiveness.
* Provide technical leadership and ensure team competency in precision metrology and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
* Lead a risk-based supplier quality program covering supplier qualification, performance monitoring, audits, and supplier corrective-action follow-up.

**4. Cross-functional Collaboration and Team Leadership**

* Partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Program teams to embed quality into design, production, and supplier processes.
* Support new product introduction (NPI) with quality planning, risk assessments, and validation activities.
* Lead and develop the Quality team through clear objectives, coaching, performance management, leadership development, and succession planning.
* Promote a proactive quality culture across the organization through training, mentorship, and leadership by example.

**Who You Are**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of aerospace quality experience, including senior leadership responsibilities and significant responsibility for AS9100-based quality systems.
* Deep working knowledge of aerospace quality principles and requirements.
* Experience working with major aerospace OEMs and their quality expectations.
* Demonstrated experience leading internal, customer, and third-party certification or regulatory audits.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, discipline, and compliance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and communicate effectively with customers, auditors, and executive leadership.
* Proven ability to lead and develop a small, high-impact Quality team.
* Demonstrated ability to lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Working knowledge of 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, including the distinction between production airworthiness approvals and maintenance return to service, and applicable FAA Form 8130-3 issuance and signatory-authorization requirements.
* Experience with FAA-certificated Part 145 repair-station requirements, including regulatory interface and oversight of inspection and return-to-service controls.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of metallurgy and material certification review.
* AS9100 lead auditor training or equivalent demonstrated experience leading aerospace QMS audits.
* Background supporting NPI, supplier quality, and manufacturing quality operations.
* An advanced degree in a related discipline.
* ASQ or other relevant quality certifications, such as CQE or CQA.

**What’s In It for You**

* Competitive salary with annual bonus eligibility.
* Benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
* Paid time off and holidays.
* 401(k) plan with employer contribution matching.
* In addition to offering competitive wages and benefits, Onboard Systems offers the opportunity to increase future earnings tied to growth in company performance. We recognize employee contributions toward growing the business through our Growth Participation Unit (GPU) program. GPUs are tied directly to company growth and reward all eligible employees with cash when the business grows over time.

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status*
